notes: Product review batch 3 (v1.11.32): five P2 ideas (P2-1–P2-5). P2-1: «بستن روز» — a button at the bottom of today's list opens a one-page summary (planned / done / real / useful + unfinished boxes) and, for each unfinished box, three choices: «به فردا», «به اولین روز خالی» (same gap rules as findGapDay) or «پنهان کن»; on confirm the day flag is computed from the boxes that remain on the day and recorded — the manual «روز کامل شد» tick is gone, so the flag can no longer lie. P2-2: open/collapsed list state is kept in memory per container across re-renders, so ticking a box no longer collapses the lists the user had open. P2-3: two-mode box card — compact by default (tick, title, time, %, timer button + «جزئیات»), with the three test fields and the manual real/useful inputs behind «جزئیات». P2-4: weighted exam readiness — weight = budget question count, an unlinked topic is an explicit zero (its weight still counts), and geometry / general subjects are shown separately as «بدون کتاب»; all 180 budget topics currently have questions = null, so the weights are equal and the app says so openly instead of inventing a count. P2-5: bulk test-count entry — three one-line fields in the box with one «ذخیره» button, per-chapter bulk entry in the test book («این فصل n تست دارد، m حل کردم، k درست», split across sections with exact sums), and tests_total inferred from an explicit number in a box title like «۳۰ تست» (a «پارت X از N تست» title does not infer N — that is the series total, not this part's). Also fixed: a custom box's total edited in the card used to be lost on re-render. Known totals unchanged: حسابان 3489, شیمی 3000; گسسته and فیزیک have none (2110 not reintroduced). The 1.11.18 examDateText live-computation fix, the 1.11.30 tick dates and Dey builder, and the 1.11.27 delete-retry fix are untouched.
